tasks.title: Доска: сети
tasks.statement: На доске вы собираете сетевую часть окружения oVirt. В четырёх сценариях: необязательная сеть, которой нет на части хостов; выделенная сеть миграции; сеть управления для каждого дата-центра; машина с необязательной сетью. Сеть определяют в дата-центре, подключают к кластеру и назначают на хосты; у неё есть роль, а обязательная сеть должна быть на каждом хосте кластера. Упражнение решено, когда цели всех сценариев выполнены.
tasks.hint: Обязательная сеть нужна каждому хосту кластера, необязательная — нет, но машина с картой в такой сети запустится только там, где сеть назначена. Выберите сеть: роль и «обязательная» меняются в инспекторе. Миграция идёт по сети с ролью «миграция», если она есть на обоих хостах, иначе по сети управления.

scenarios.title: A network only one host has
scenarios.story: The backup network is attached to the cluster, but only host-1 has a NIC for it. The network is required, so host-2 and host-3 are NonOperational: a required network has to be on every host of the cluster.
scenarios.goal: Every host works and the backup network is optional
scenarios.hint: Select the backup network and clear “required”. An optional network may be missing on some hosts.

scenarios.title: A migration network of its own
scenarios.story: Live migration pushes the whole memory of a VM through the network. Without a dedicated network it shares the management network with the commands of the engine. Give migration a network of its own.
scenarios.goal: The VM can be migrated and its memory goes over a migration network
scenarios.hint: Define a network with the migration role in the data center, attach it to the cluster and assign it to both hosts. Migration prefers such a network to the management one.

scenarios.title: A management network for each data center
scenarios.story: A second data center was added. Its host is NonResponsive: the engine has no way in. Each data center needs a network that has the management role and a NIC of the engine.
scenarios.hint: Two things are wrong with the new network: its role and the engine's NIC in it.

scenarios.title: An optional network and a VM
scenarios.story: The vm-net network is optional: a host without it stays Up. But a VM with a NIC in vm-net can only run where the network is assigned, so it cannot move to host-2.
scenarios.goal: The VM can be migrated and vm-net stays optional
scenarios.hint: The host needs the network of the VM's NIC, even though the network does not have to be there for the host to be Up.

tasks.title: Доска: сети, уровень 2
tasks.statement: Вы собираете и чините сети окружения oVirt на доске: создаёте сети, подключаете их к кластерам и назначаете хостам. Пять сценариев: сеть создана, но не подключена, и машина не запускается; сеть консолей, которой нет на старом хосте; второй кластер, которому каждую сеть дата-центра нужно подключить отдельно; хост без сети управления, которому не помогает флаг «необязательная»; добавление нового хоста со всеми сетями и хранилищем. Упражнение решено, когда решены все сценарии.
tasks.hint: Цепочка всегда одна: создать сеть в дата-центре, подключить к кластеру, назначить сетевой карте хоста. Выберите хост или машину и прочитайте, чего ей не хватает.

scenarios.title: Defined, but not attached
scenarios.story: The VM web-1 has a NIC in the app-net network, and both hosts are Up, yet the VM does not start. The network exists in the data center, but something between the data center and the hosts is missing.
scenarios.goal: web-1 runs and can be migrated to host-2
scenarios.hint: A network defined in a data center does nothing until it is attached to a cluster and assigned to the NIC of every host that needs it. Select the VM to read why it is down.

scenarios.title: A console network for some hosts
scenarios.story: Operators open VM consoles from their laptops and want the console traffic on a network of its own. Host-3 is an old machine with a single NIC and cannot take one more network.
scenarios.goal: A display network is on host-1 and host-2, and all three hosts stay Up
scenarios.hint: Give the new network the display role and clear “required”. A required network has to be on every host of the cluster, an optional one does not.

scenarios.title: A second cluster, the same networks
scenarios.story: Cluster-b was added to the data center with host-3 and a VM web-2, but host-3 is NonResponsive. The networks belong to the data center, yet cluster-b has none of them.
scenarios.goal: host-3 is Up and web-2 runs on it
scenarios.hint: Defined in the data center means available, not attached. Every cluster gets the networks it needs on its own, and every host of it still puts them on a NIC.

scenarios.title: Management cannot be optional
scenarios.story: Host-3 is NonResponsive. Last week someone made ovirtmgmt optional, hoping that a host without it would simply stay Up, but host-3 is still down, and there is more wrong behind this.
scenarios.goal: All three hosts are Up and the management network is required again
scenarios.hint: Without a management network the engine has no way to reach the host at all, so it is NonResponsive whatever the flag says. Fix the path first, then read the status again.

scenarios.title: Scale out with a new host
scenarios.story: The cluster is short of capacity. A new host-3 has to join cluster-a, and a fresh host has nothing: no networks and no storage.
scenarios.goal: Three hosts are Up and host-3 is a member of the cluster
scenarios.hint: Select the host and read why it is not Up: every missing required network and storage domain is listed. An optional network does not have to be there.

tasks.title: Доска: сети, уровень 3
tasks.statement: Вы разбираетесь, как по сетям oVirt идут живая миграция и рост кластера: по какой сети едет память машины и каким хостам нужна какая сеть. Пять сценариев: машина с двумя сетевыми картами и миграция; сеть миграции, которой нет на части хостов, и память идёт по сети управления; сеть с ролью «машины» вместо «миграции»; обязательная сеть для уже работающего кластера; одна сеть на каждую роль. Упражнение решено, когда решены все сценарии.
tasks.hint: Миграция берёт сеть по роли и только если она назначена и источнику, и цели; все карты машины должны найти свои сети на целевом хосте. Пройдите путь миграции и посмотрите, по какой сети она идёт.

scenarios.title: A VM with two NICs migrates
scenarios.story: web-1 has two NICs, one in front-net and one in back-net, and runs on host-1. Host-2 is NonOperational, and the VM cannot be migrated anywhere.
scenarios.goal: Everything works and web-1 can be migrated to host-2 with both NICs
scenarios.hint: A VM keeps all its NICs when it moves, so the target host needs the network of every one of them. One of the two networks is not required, so the portal does not complain about it.

scenarios.title: Migration over the wrong network
scenarios.story: Every host is Up and every VM can be migrated, yet the migration network is hardly used: the memory of web-1, web-2 and web-3 still travels over the management network.
scenarios.goal: The memory of every migration goes over the migration network
scenarios.hint: Live migration uses a migration network only if both the source and the target host have it. Follow the path of a migration to see which network it takes.

scenarios.title: The name is not the role
scenarios.story: The migration-net network is attached to the cluster and assigned to both hosts, but migrations still go over the management network.
scenarios.goal: The memory of a migration goes over a network with the migration role
scenarios.hint: The engine chooses the network for a migration by its role, not by its name. Select the network and look at its parameters.

scenarios.title: A required network for a live cluster
scenarios.story: The application moves to a second network, db-net, and web-1 needs a NIC in it. Three hosts are Up and web-1 is running.
scenarios.goal: db-net is on every host, web-1 has a NIC in it, and everything works
scenarios.hint: A new network is required by default: as soon as it is attached to the cluster, every host without it becomes NonOperational. Assign it to all hosts.

scenarios.title: One network for each role
scenarios.story: A new environment must separate its traffic: iSCSI storage, VM migration and consoles each get a network of their own, next to the management and VM networks. For now the hosts are NonOperational.
scenarios.goal: Management, VM, storage, migration and display networks all work on both hosts
scenarios.hint: Every network is defined in the data center, attached to the cluster and assigned to both hosts, and the role is a parameter of the network. The iSCSI domain needs the storage role, and migrations use the migration one.
